traditional: 搞到 A 透唔到氣
jyutping: gaau2 dou2 A tau3 m4 dou2 hei3

english.note: Use this when an obstruction, fumes, strangling, or tight clothing causes someone to be unable to breathe.

examples.english: The smoke makes me choke, and I can't breathe.
examples.jyutping: di1 jin1 gaau2 dou2 ngo5 tau3 m4 dou2 hei3
